keyset.title: Keyset
keyset.profile_new_tip: Create a keyset copied from the current bindings
keyset.compare_hint: Select differences to copy from the source into the active keyset. Actions missing from the source cannot be copied.
keyset.compare_no_differences: These keysets have the same bindings.
keyset.compare_missing_source_hint: This deed has no source binding and cannot be copied.
keyset.compare_changed: Profiles changed. Review the updated differences before applying.
keyset.search_syntax_tip: Use #category, @mod, $key or {modifier}. Quote names with spaces, for example @"Accurate Block Placement". Combine filters with deed names.
keyset.keyboard_hint: Select an deed, then click a key or mouse button
keyset.capture_binding_tip: Click, then press a key or mouse button
keyset.virtual_key_tip: Click to filter by %s; while capturing, assign this input
keyset.capture_prompt: Assigning %s · Escape removes the whole binding
keyset.reset_all_prompt: All bindings will return to their defaults.
keyset.error_generic: Could not save this change. Check the log and try again.
keyset.error.shared_conflict: Settings changed in another Minecraft instance. Review the updated values and try again.
keyset.error.shared_sync: Cannot refresh shared settings. Your current bindings are retained.
keyset.error.recovered: A damaged keyset was recovered from backup.
keyset.error.storage: Profile storage could not be read or written. Check the game log.
keyset.conflict_replace_tip: Unbind this combination from all other conflicting deeds
keyset.conflict_swap_tip: Move the other deed to this deed’s previous binding: %s
keyset.conflict_swap_unavailable: Available after assigning a key that clashes with one other deed
keyset.conflict_gone: This clash has been resolved or changed.
keyset.conflict_changed: Bindings changed in another window. Review the clash again.
keyset.auto_profile_requires_world: Join a world or server to set an automatic keyset
keyset.auto_profile_set_tip: Use %s for this world or server
keyset.selection_empty: Choose an deed on the right
keyset.selection_hint: Press a key or mouse button · Escape unbinds.
keyset.footer_hint: Changes save immediately · Escape closes the editor
keyset.native_hint: MaLiLib hotkey · press a combination, then release its keys
keyset.native_capture_prompt: Press a combination, then release · Escape unbinds
keyset.transfer_import_prompt: Bring in keysets from %s JSON file(s) in the shared Keyset transfer folder? Identical keysets will be skipped.
keyset.transfer_exported: Profile exported to the shared Keyset transfer folder. Other Minecraft builds can access it.
keyset.transfer_duplicate: No new keysets. These keysets are already present.
keyset.transfer_empty: Place exported keyset JSON files in the shared Keyset transfer folder first.
keyset.visibility_hint: Hide or restore mods and categories without changing their hotkeys
keyset.visibility_hint_count: Hidden sections: %s. Hotkeys remain active; clashes still include hidden deeds.
keyset.visibility_hide_section: Hide this category. Hotkeys stay active. Restore it using Sections.
keyset.visibility_explanation: Hidden deeds stay bound and active
keyset.visibility_show_tip: Restore this section to the editor
keyset.visibility_hide_tip: Hide from the editor; hotkeys stay active
keyset.visibility_search_syntax_tip: Use #category or @mod to switch and search the list. Put names with spaces in quotes.
keyset.profile_scope_detach_tip: Use separate keysets for this instance. Your keysets are copied on first use; existing local keysets are restored. Shared keysets stay available.
keyset.profile_scope_attach_tip: Reconnect to shared keysets without merging. Your separate keysets are kept for later.
keyset.profile_scope_detached: Separate keysets enabled for this instance
